name: init_comb
title: init seed on a purely combinational gate (transient, reset-restored)
description: buf is a buffer (OR with both inputs tied to A) seeded to 1 by init. With no feedback the seed is transient: O reads 1 at cycle 0 (clean read, no tick) but the first tick recomputes O := A OR A, so the seed does not stick; reset re-applies it. Pins AMB-3/AMB-39 power-on state at cycle 0 vs after a tick.
